name: Super Sport Gen2
summary: Endurance/all-road platform with 40C capability and attractive launch configurations. Better for rough roads and dry hardpack than deep gravel.

frame.claimed_frame_weight_basis: Public scale measurement of a painted XS frame: 1,146.9 g; frame-only inclusions were not fully documented.

tire_clearance.note: Launch coverage states 40C capability; leave more caution for mud than on a true 45–50C gravel frame.
